title: Project Starlight and the 2001 National Press Club event

tellings.quote: It was called Project Starlight code name. We were private and then it went public in 01 with the National Press Club that had 800 million people see it.

plain: Steven Greer, a guest who says he ran the effort himself, describes a private project code-named Project Starlight that, by his account, worked out of public view from 1993. He says it went public in 2001 at the National Press Club, a Washington venue for news events, and that 800 million people saw it. He tells it on American Alchemy as a step toward bringing hidden UFO knowledge into the open.
